pr.title: Add a Files changed pane to the top of a summary page
pr.head: 2acc465564668232d1b07eb77b7e4bf0a0018c65

summary: A summary page, the guided review page that project site page renders from a summary's JSON, groups a pull request's files into sections in reading order. Before this change, a reader who wanted one file had to know which section held it. The only file lists were each section's own Files in this section bar, and nothing listed the files that start collapsed, such as generated code, tests, and docs, apart from the rest.

This change adds a Files changed pane at the top of the page's main column, above the overview. It lists every file in the diff, sorted by path, with its new or deleted badge and its added and removed line counts. The files that start collapsed in the diff sit in a closed list of their own below the rest. Clicking a file unfolds its section, opens the file, and scrolls to it, even when the URL hash already names that file. A file marked Reviewed shows a check in the pane. The sidebar gains a Files changed link above Overview.
The pull request is stacked on #196, which moves the version list and adds the stack list in the sidebar. Its head merges that branch, and the merge leaves this pull request's own diff unchanged.

cards.title: Terms on this page
cards.html:
• Collapsed file: a file card whose diff starts hidden. By default that is a file whose kind is generated, test, or docs. A summary overrides the default per file with collapsed.
  • Folded section: a group whose body is hidden, for example after the reader marks it Reviewed.
  • fid: a file card's element id, f- plus ten hex digits of the SHA-1 of its path, which src/projector/summary.py generates.

groups.title: The Files changed pane
groups.kicker: What the pane renders, how it navigates, and how it tracks Reviewed state.
intro: The renderer in site/src/summary.ts builds the whole page as one HTML string in renderSummary, then wireSummary attaches the click handlers and restores each checkbox from localStorage. The pane follows the same split.

1. Rendering. renderFilesPane collects every file from every group, sorts them by path, and splits them into an open list and a closed list with startsCollapsed. That function is the rule each file card already used, so a file sits in the closed list exactly when its card starts collapsed.
  2. Navigation. Each row is a link to its file card's fid. A click pushes the hash with history.pushState and calls reveal, which unfolds the section, opens the file, and scrolls to it. A plain hash change runs the same reveal without forcing a scroll, because the browser has already scrolled.
  3. Reviewed state. syncJump copies a file card's reviewed class to its pane row. It runs in markFile and when the page restores Reviewed state on load.
The stylesheet draws the pane as two <details> elements with the page's own chevron, and draws the Reviewed check with the --check-icon and --ok tokens, which both themes define.

checks.text: The validation gate passed at this head in a scratch worktree: npm run check reported no findings, npm run build left site/assets/summary.js unchanged, and all 455 Python tests passed with no skip.

files.note: Adds startsCollapsed, splitPath, renderFilesPane, syncJump, and reveal, and wires the pane's links.

checks.text: startsCollapsed returns the same expression renderFile computed inline before, so the pane's open and closed lists match how each card starts. Checked by comparing the removed and added lines.

The pane takes the element id files, as the overview already takes overview. A summary that names a group or an overview card files produces a duplicate id, and that group's sidebar link then jumps to the pane. Decide whether the build should refuse both reserved ids.
The closed list's label names generated, test, and docs files. A source file that a summary marks collapsed: true also lands here, under that label.

Every place that sets a file card's reviewed class also calls syncJump: here in markFile, and in the restore on load. A section's Reviewed box never marks a file, so it needs no sync. Checked by searching for every classList.toggle('reviewed'.

The handler calls preventDefault on every click, so a Ctrl-click or a Cmd-click on a row stays in the same tab instead of opening a new one. Decide whether to return early when a modifier key is held.

files.note: Styles the pane, its collapsed sublist, and the Reviewed check, using only existing theme tokens.

groups.title: Skill documentation
groups.kicker: The summarize-pr skill mentions the new list.
intro: The summarize-pr skill tells the agent that writes a summary which files start collapsed. It now adds that the Files changed list keeps those files in a closed list of their own.
